title: Doctor on How Screen Time Hurts Kids' Cognitive Development
summary: A five-minute C-SPAN clip of Dr. Jared Cooney Horvath testifying to a US Senate committee that screen time, including in schools, harms children's learning and cognitive development.
why: HN commenters link it as a concise piece of expert testimony in threads on declining test scores and technology in education.
